1.t: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;

2.t: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).

3.t: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?

4.t: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.

5.t: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.

6.t: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

7.t: At length, when the sight is dazed,

8.t: And the moon is buried in darkness.

9.t: And the sun and moon are joined together,-

10.t: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"

11.t: By no means! No place of safety!

12.t: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.

13.t: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.

14.t: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,

15.t: Even though he were to put up his excuses.

16.t: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.

17.t: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:

18.t: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):

19.t: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):

20.t: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,

22.t: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-

24.t: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,

25.t: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;

26.t: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),

27.t: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"

28.t: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;

29.t: And one leg will be joined with another:

30.t: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!

31.t: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-

32.t: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!

33.t: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!

34.t: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

35.t: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

36.t: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?

37.t: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?

38.t: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.

39.t: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.

40.t: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
